visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a large red bow in her hair sits on a light grey sofa, wearing a white t-shirt and professional over-ear headphones. She holds a smartphone in her right hand while a large condenser microphone is positioned in front of her. A large pink plush toy rests beside her as she gestures with her left hand toward the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a man sitting on the same sofa; he wears a black baseball cap, dark-rimmed glasses, and a black mesh vest over a white t-shirt. He also has headphones and a microphone, holding a tan cat plushie while speaking animatedly. (3) The editing switches back to the woman who is laughing heartily, covering her mouth with her hand, then showing vibrant text overlays appearing on screen. (4) The man is shown again, gesturing with open palms while looking toward the woman off-camera. The background remains a simple off-white wall with a small minimalist picture frame. (5) The woman leans in closer to the microphone, her expression becoming more focused and serious as she explains a point. (6) [Subtitle]: 那你早上上課早下課. (7) [Subtitle]: 你早點滑手機. (8) [Subtitle]: 隔天還是一個循環. (9) [Subtitle]: 那不是一樣的道理嗎？. (10) [Subtitle]: 你早下課回去就是滑更久的手機啊. (11) [Subtitle]: 那就是你的問題啊！. (19) [Subtitle]: 上班的時間政策也訂到10點之後. (20) [Subtitle]: 那有家長就問老闆. (21) [Subtitle]: 老闆的回答就說... . (22) [Subtitle]: 「你可以試試看啊」. (23) [Subtitle]: 你隔天大概就不用來之類的. (24) [Slogan]: 每月親子報爆(9-10月)!.
